title: O Bruxo
_info: Roteiro do conto. 'speakers' diz quem fala em cada parágrafo de diálogo (ids do book.json). Cada quadro em 'frames' começa no parágrafo 'start' e vai até o início do próximo. 'chars' injeta a aparência dos personagens (characters.json) no prompt; 'place' injeta o cenário.

places.street: narrow deserted medieval town street at dusk, closed wooden market stalls, warm summer evening
places.tavern: dim shabby medieval tavern interior, wooden counter, barrels, oil lamps, smoky air
places.office: town governor's study, heavy oak table, candles, parchment, stone walls
places.hall: royal hall of a new castle, big fireplace, straw on the floor, tapestries
places.guardroom: small room above a guardhouse at night, whitewashed walls, wooden beams, one candle
places.old_castle: abandoned ruined castle hall at night, broken furniture, dust, moonlight through high windows, staircase with balustrade
places.crypt: small stone crypt under the castle, three stone sarcophagi, darkness
